# Asia Chip Market Tightens, Prices Surge Fast  
**Bottom line:** Supply is elevated and prices are rising sharply; lock in pricing where advised and push for lead‑time reductions this week.  

## What changed
- Market supply risk holds at 73 (no change) while price‑trend climbs to 88.2, up 0.3 points [source 1].  
- Producer price index up +32.6 % annualised over 3 months, tightening both supply and price [1].  
- Global chip sales hit $172.6 B in Sep 2026, +148.3 % YoY, driving demand pressure [2].  
- TSMC revenue growth 56 % YoY through Oct 2026, outpacing typical 33.6 %, signaling tighter fab capacity [3].  

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time 14 weeks; channel stock 27,071 units (≈17.6 weeks of supply).  
- Price $5.56 for qty 1, $2.51 for 1 k units.  
- Origin Austria, tariff 0 % (no surcharge).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 63 % chance prices rise in 3 months but supply is adequate, so fix price now and keep normal order cadence.  

## Alerts  

*(none)*  

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – Supply 72 (Elevated), Price 85.1 (Rising fast), High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – Supply 70.1 (Elevated), Price 77.2 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Analog & power management – Supply 69.8 (Rising), Price 83.0 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – Supply 68.3 (Rising), Price 82.4 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – Supply 67.3 (Rising), Price 85.6 (Rising fast), High confidence.  

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – 52‑week lead time vs 12‑week norm, supply risk 80.  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk 80.  
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk 80.  
- **IS25LP128-JBLE** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk 78.4.  
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9-0SIT** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk 78.1, price +2257 % vs target.  

## Outlook
- Chip prices have a **70 %** chance to rise in the next 3 months (expected +2.5 %, 80 % range ‑9.2 % to +14.2 %) – model‑based edge.  
- In 6 months, price‑rise probability falls to **56 %** (expected +5.0 %, 80 % range ‑10.2 % to +20.3 %) – trend‑following baseline.  
- Fab utilization likely tightens: 62 % chance of a rise in 3 months (expected +1.8 pts) and 60 % in 6 months (expected +3.6 pts).  
- Buy‑timing: lock pricing on parts listed under “Buy ahead / lock pricing” (including the featured MOSFET) and defer ahead‑of‑time purchases for “Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)” items.  

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock prices now** on high‑risk, long‑lead‑time parts (e.g., 10M08SAE144C8G, LCMXO2‑1200HC‑4TG100C) to avoid the 63 %‑plus price‑rise risk.  
2. **Request lead‑time reductions or priority slots** from foundry‑linked suppliers, citing TSMC’s 56 % YoY revenue surge as evidence of capacity strain.  
3. **Leverage the neutral supply rating of the featured MOSFET** to negotiate volume discounts while keeping order cadence unchanged, since channel stock is sufficient.
